ios.desc:
ClearVoice is an on-device text to speech app, using the latest state of the art OmniVoice model. All voices are generated offline, and saved only to your own device, no sign-up or internet connection is required. Great for generating audiobooks, public announcements, and language practice.

Features:
• Generate natural language speech from text
• Clone a voice with only 10 seconds of audio and a transcript
• Generate audio in over 250 languages
• Share audio easily after generation

Disclaimer: The included voices are for demonstration purposes only, please only use your own authorised voices. Always obtain consent before cloning and sharing.

show_hn.title: Show HN: ClearVoice TTS, SOTA voice cloning model running offline, in an iOS app

quotes.text:
This is the first app I am aware of that can run a voice model of this quality on iPhone or iPad. It uses 6GB of RAM at peak, so most modern Macs, and some iPhone and iPad models should work (I’ve tested on a 17 pro). The model used is OmniVoice, which is known mostly for its ability to generate quality tts in hundreds of languages.

This probably isn’t the fastest implementation of OmniVoice on a Mac, but it’s got to be the easiest to run on macOS, and, as far as I know, the only existing implementation on iOS.

Demo of it running on an M3 MacBook Air: https://x.com/RoryClear/status/2090414148030972300
